notes.title: Get Ready for Cosmic Lighthouse at Steam's Eastern Game Fest!
notes.notes:
Good evening, everyone!
[Cosmic Lighthouse] is aa pixel-art AVG game that combines fortune-telling with a sci-fi theme, and it’s will be participating in the Eastern Game Fest Sale 2025 from 10:00 AM (PT), April 23 to 10:00 AM (PT), May 2, 2025!
Let go of the urge to "fix" others—respect the course of their destiny. If you’re a fan of narrative metaphysical games, don’t forget to add this game to your wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299439/737e40111de5b12ff6de54e5955dbce277488859.jpg[/img]

In the game, you will take on the role of a diviner at the "Cosmic Lighthouse" airport, providing fortune-telling services to travelers and answering their questions as a way to make a living and strive to survive.
If you enjoy our game, feel free to join the official Discord group: https://discord.gg/jcT6AaUM35 to stay up to date with the latest news and updates!

notes.title: Get Ready for Cosmic Lighthouse at Steam's Lunar New Year Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello gamers! Cosmic Lighthouse will soon be participating in Steam's Lunar New Year Sale! Come join the event and get an awesome gaming experience. If you like text-based metaphysical games, you are welcome to add Cosmic Lighthouse to your steam wishlist! 

Event Period: From 10:00, Jan. 26, 2025 to 10:00, Feb. 9, 2025 (PT)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299439/ff345fbb7149e45f1dcd39282d2850fe12160904.png[/img]

The Cosmic Lighthouse is a pixel-style AVG game that combines fortune-telling with sci-fi themes. During the course of the game, you will play as a space fortuneteller at the airport, answering travellers' questions by telling their fortunes, and ultimately becoming a heart-warming icon in the universe that redeems travellers!
